title: Payment E104
text: E104 is a payment gateway timeout. Retry idempotently and inspect upstream latency.

title: Kubernetes OOMKilled
text: OOMKilled means a container exceeded its memory limit. Inspect requests, limits and runtime memory.

title: RAG evaluation
text: Retrieval quality should be measured with Recall, MRR or nDCG before generation quality is assessed.

title: Vector index drift
text: Embedding model changes require index versioning and re-embedding because vector spaces are not interchangeable.
